# Bitcoin Stratigraphy Data Engine — Bitcoin Analytics, Proofs, and Agent Receipts

> Bitcoin Stratigraphy (v2.1.3, https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com) serves indexed
> Bitcoin telemetry, cryptographic verification, OpenTimestamps notarization and
> off-chain Bitcoin-tip receipts through 16 canonical MCP tools and paid REST
> routes, settled with L402 Lightning payments. MCP stratigraphy tools serve
> captured UTC pipeline snapshots as described by `tools/list`; the REST dataset
> and Hugging Face export use deterministic daily height labels, not live-tip
> data or native per-record Bitcoin block provenance.

## Agent entry points
- [Interactive Developer Portal & Live Tool Explorer](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/docs): live schemas and a manual playground for 15 MCP tools across 4 namespaces, including OpenTimestamps notarization.
- [Python SDK and integration cookbooks](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/cookbooks): CrewAI, LangChain and AutoGen examples; [HTTPX Python SDK/client source](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/cookbooks/l402_client.py). Payments require explicit callbacks.
- [MCP auto-discovery manifest](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/mcp.json): transport, tool descriptors, settlement paths, documentation links and pricing methods.
- [Complete tool schemas, settlement guide and TypeScript SDK usage](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/llms-full.txt)
- [MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/mcp): POST JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, starting with `tools/list`; this is a protocol endpoint, not a browsable HTML page.
- [Pre-flight price discovery](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/api/v1/cost): GET REST tiers; POST `{"tools":["stratigraphy.get_latest","proof.verify_zk_proof"]}` for itemized MCP prices. These selectors map to canonical `stratigraphy.get` and `proof.verify` for pricing only. Quotes create no invoices. Paid MCP credentials are tool-scoped: one call by default, or 100 calls with an explicit 100x-priced batch purchase.
- [Paid REST telemetry stream](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/api/v1/stratigraphy/stream): `GET` Server-Sent Events with a 30-second refresh interval. This is a separate REST transport, not MCP; consult `/api/v1/cost` for the current price and assets.
- [OpenAPI document](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/openapi.json)
- [MCP server card](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Health](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/api/healthz)
- [Public Hugging Face JSONL dataset export](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/api/export/huggingface): source-grounded instruction/response records; use `?format=json&limit=100` for a JSON array.
- [Machine-readable LLM schema manifest](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/llm-schema.json): export parameters, field definitions, domain constraints, and verification protocols.

## Install and connect
Hosted agents connect any MCP Streamable HTTP client to
https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/mcp. To run the self-hosted engine:

```sh
npx -y @bitcoin-stratigraphy/mcp-server
```

The package starts a Streamable HTTP server at `http://127.0.0.1:8008/mcp`
(set `PORT` to change it); it is not a stdio connector. It requires Node.js 22+,
PostgreSQL (`DATABASE_URL`), `SESSION_SECRET` and `NOSTR_PRIVATE_KEY`; live
Lightning requires `NWC_URI`, and the canonical stratigraphy tools require the
licensed Python companion described in the package README.

## The 16 canonical MCP tools

- `workflow.audit_trajectory` (250 sats): one deterministic diff and compact
  SHA-256/OTS receipt-reference report for required `fromTarget` and `toTarget`.
  Accepts the same real-height/UTC-date selectors as get_diff. Live boundaries
  have a fingerprint and null archived receipt, not fabricated Bitcoin proof.
Only `stratigraphy.list` (alias `stratigraphy.latest`) and `proof.list` (alias
`proof.status`) are free. The other thirteen are paid per call (currently 250
sats each); confirm live prices with `payment.get_info` or `/api/v1/cost`.

- `stratigraphy.list` (free): discover UTC archive bounds, the current Bitcoin tip height and catalog metadata, without paid snapshot or proof bytes.
- `stratigraphy.get`: retrieve full live pipeline telemetry and selected archived UTC snapshots with their OpenTimestamps receipts.
- `stratigraphy.get_digest`: fetch SHA-256 fingerprints of archived or live pipeline JSON (not Bitcoin block hashes or ZK proofs) with associated receipts.
- `stratigraphy.get_diff`: compute signed deltas between two live or archived snapshots, including the 15 J/TH power change.
- `stratigraphy.get_range`: retrieve fingerprints for a contiguous span of captured UTC snapshots bounded by heights or dates.
- `proof.attenuate`: narrow an authentic, unexpired L402 parent macaroon with restrictive caveats and an optional TTL.
- `proof.verify`: verify supplied Groth16 telemetry or drift proofs, or OpenTimestamps receipts.
- `proof.get_by_hash`: retrieve a retained proof payload, signed receipt or lifecycle status by hash or job ID.
- `proof.list` (free): discover and paginate recent proof-attestation lifecycle summaries.
- `proof.submit`: register a new Groth16 proof with its five public signals and attempt a Nostr NIP-78 attestation.
- `proof.notarize`: create a detached OpenTimestamps receipt for a SHA-256 digest using public calendars.
- `proof.ground`: issue an off-chain Schnorr-signed Bitcoin-tip receipt for agent context or a dataset CID.
- `mesh.get_status`: inspect peer counts, topology health, cross-validation rate, latency and quorum.
- `mesh.broadcast`: sign a stored daily telemetry snapshot and distribute it to pinned mesh peers.
- `payment.get_info`: query MCP pricing or verify authenticated settlement.

## Access and settlement
A paid call without credentials returns HTTP 402 with
`WWW-Authenticate: L402 macaroon="<macaroon>", invoice="<BOLT11>"` and a JSON
body that names both settlement paths, links the genesis receipt and includes a
pre-flight summary. Pay the exact invoice, then retry the identical request:

- Path A (`sha256_preimage`): `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>` with
  the wallet's 64-character hex preimage.
- Path B (`nwc_lookup`): `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:NWC_LOOKUP` when a
  custodial wallet (for example CoinOS or Cash App) does not reveal the
  preimage. The issuing merchant wallet must confirm the exact incoming invoice;
  HTTP 409 means confirmation is pending, so retry with the same macaroon and do
  not pay again.

Agents can use an L402-capable wrapper such as Lightning Labs `lnget` or
`lightning-enable-mcp`; see
[the canonical payment and sandbox guide](https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/.well-known/llms.txt).
For 100 calls to one paid tool, request its challenge with
`X-L402-Batch-Size: 100`, pay the 100x invoice once, and reuse that credential
within its expiry and quota. Delegation does not reset the quota. Never log or
publish the bearer credential.

Public metadata, health, MCP tool discovery, and the Hugging Face export need
no payment. Paid operations use endpoint-specific prices and return the
applicable challenge; use the actual challenge rather than relying on a static
price. The L402 router supports `btc-lightning`, `l-btc`, and `taproot-assets`
where available. MCP supports Lightning L402; Base USDC x402 is conditional and
only applies to MCP when explicitly reported available. Do not infer Base USDC
availability for REST or the SSE stream. The SDK's REST client may use a
REST-scoped subscription credential; MCP credentials cannot cross tools or REST
routes.

## Genesis settlement proof
- Escrow ID: `ba4f25dd-7f16-420c-9264-a16f102fd5a6`
- Merkle root: `d8cd6fe5a388e9422ccc6006969fb01c716291c14b1e85dc4e8a75c2ad134da6`
- Settled at strata block: 971341
- Toll: 24 sats, settled over Lightning on mainnet
- Receipt: https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/api/v1/escrow/genesis-receipt

This is the operator's historical Lightning settlement plus an RFC 6962
execution commitment. It is not an on-chain Bitcoin transaction or an
OpenTimestamps confirmation.

## Capabilities and trust boundaries
- `proof.attenuate` cannot widen authority or create a paid parent entitlement;
  child redemption still requires the parent's payment proof.
- Groth16/Poseidon BN254 telemetry verification, the drift proof path and
  OpenTimestamps receipt verification are distinct modes.
- `proof.ground` receipts are signed anchors, not ZK proofs, proof of work or
  Bitcoin transactions.
- The Nostr NIP-01/78 mesh uses pinned reciprocal peers for signed broadcasts
  and quorum checks. Peer agreement is not source truth.
- REST dataset and export heights are deterministic daily index labels, not
  observed per-record Bitcoin blocks or the live Bitcoin tip.

## License and commercial exemption
The engine is licensed under AGPLv3 (`(AGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Commercial)`).
AGPL warning: AGPLv3 is a strong network copyleft license. If you modify the
engine and users interact with your modified version over a network, Section 13
requires you to offer those users its complete Corresponding Source under
AGPLv3; conveying the engine or a work based on it carries the same obligation.
Independent programs that only exchange data with the engine over HTTP or MCP,
and separately trained model weights, are not automatically covered. Confirm
your architecture with counsel.

Organizations that cannot meet those obligations can obtain a Commercial
Enterprise Exemption License:
- Price: Starting at $250k/Annual.
- Delivery: "AS IS" self-hosted, air-gapped delivery on infrastructure you control.
- Service levels: zero SLAs; your team installs, operates, patches and secures the deployment.
- Contact: licensing@bitcoinstratigraphy.com. CISO due-diligence brief:
  https://bitcoinstratigraphy.com/api/v1/enterprise/due-diligence-brief

API fees and payment credentials do not purchase a software license. The
dataset metadata declares CC BY 4.0; access to paid API data is separately
governed by L402.
